question: Who has been appointed as the Chairperson of Fertilizer Association of India (FAI) in June 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Sailesh C. Mehta**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Sailesh C. Mehta** was appointed as the Chairperson of the **Fertilizer Association of India (FAI)** in **June 2025**. • The Fertilizer Association of India (**FAI**) is a non-profit, non-trading organization established to represent the fertilizer sector in India. • As Chairperson, **Sailesh C. Mehta** will focus on driving initiatives related to sustainable agriculture, ensuring efficient fertilizer distribution, and promoting balanced fertilizer use. • His appointment is expected to bring innovative strategies to address challenges such as soil health degradation and the need for environmentally friendly fertilizers. • **FAI** plays a critical role in coordinating with the government and industry stakeholders to ensure the availability of fertilizers and promote policies for agricultural growth.
